name: Onda Media Station
short_description: Plantilla completa para radios, podcasts, medios locales y canales de contenido: web publica con directo, programacion, programas, noticias, multimedia, equipo y contacto; admin privado para gestionar parrilla, hosts, articulos, media, banners, sponsors, mensajes y ajustes.
long_description: Vertical mixed para emisoras de radio, podcasts, medios locales, newsletters editoriales y canales de contenido. Incluye una experiencia publica con home editorial, reproductor/directo, parrilla semanal, fichas de programas, archivo multimedia, noticias, equipo y formulario de contacto. El area admin permite gestionar programas, horarios, presentadores, articulos, media, banners, sponsors, mensajes recibidos y ajustes de marca. Stack Vite + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind 3 + shadcn/ui + react-router-dom. Backend con tablas para settings, programs, hosts, program_hosts, schedule_slots, articles, media_items, sponsors, banners y contact_messages, mas endpoints publicos y privados listos para usar.

first_message_examples: Quiero una web para mi radio local con programacion y noticias
Necesito una pagina para mi podcast con episodios, equipo y contacto
Hazme una emisora online con directo, parrilla y articulos
Crea un medio local con noticias, programas y panel para gestionarlo
Quiero una web para un canal de contenido con multimedia y sponsors
Necesito una plataforma para presentar mis programas y publicar noticias
Haz una web para una radio con equipo, horario semanal y formulario
Quiero gestionar articulos, banners y mensajes de mi emisora
negative_examples: Quiero una tienda online con carrito y pagos
Necesito una app de reservas con agenda de citas
Una clinica con pacientes e historial medico
Un gimnasio con membresias y check-ins
Una barberia con peluqueros y reservas
Un restaurante con carta QR y comandas
best_for: Radios locales, emisoras online y podcasts con varios programas.
Medios pequenos que necesitan publicar noticias, horarios y multimedia sin montar un CMS pesado.
Proyectos donde la parte publica y el admin editorial deben salir funcionando desde el primer build.
Canales que quieren directo, parrilla, presentadores, sponsors y formulario de contacto.
not_for: Tiendas online, reservas, clinicas, restaurantes o apps de gestion generica.
Plataformas de streaming con subida pesada de video, CDN propio o monetizacion avanzada por suscripcion.
Marketplaces multi-creador con cuentas de creador independientes.

agent_decision_signals.ambiguous_signal_action: Prefer this template when the user asks for a media, radio, podcast, news, magazine, or content-channel site with admin editing.

access_profile.notes: Public pages live under /, /programacion, /programas, /noticias, /multimedia, /equipo and /contacto. Admin is protected under /admin/*.

routes.name: Home
routes.purpose: Editorial landing with live stream, today schedule, featured programs, articles and media.

frontend_contract.ui_system: Radix primitives, lucide-react, sonner, React Query

guidance: Public endpoints support home, schedule, programs, articles, media, hosts and contact.
Admin endpoints require authenticated admin users and are used by /admin/* pages.
Do not rebuild the backend from scratch for media/radio use cases; adapt the existing endpoints and tables.

tables.name: settings
tables.purpose: Station brand, contact, stream and social settings.

tables.name: media_items
tables.purpose: Audio, video, YouTube, Spotify or embed media archive.

customization_targets.description: Station/podcast/news brand name, tagline, live stream, announcement and public nav.
Public editorial surfaces: schedule, programs, articles, media archive and team.
Listener/contact form and public message capture endpoint.
HSL design tokens for broadcast/editorial brand.

default_first_screen.shape: Full media landing with live/on-air hero, schedule, programs, articles, media and sponsors.
default_first_screen.data_strategy: Use the baked DYPAI backend seed data, then adapt brand/content to the user's media project.
default_first_screen.interaction: Public links navigate to real pages; contact submits to submit-contact-message; admin CRUD pages call real endpoints.

backend_expectations: list-public-home returns settings and arrays for schedule/articles/media/programs/sponsors.

already_included: Mixed public + admin media station for radio, podcast, articles, programs, schedule, hosts, sponsors, banners and contact messages.
Public routes for home, schedule, programs, articles, multimedia, team and contact.
Protected admin editorial dashboard under /admin with programs, schedule, hosts, articles, media, sponsors, banners, messages and settings.
Backend schema with settings, programs, hosts, schedule_slots, articles, media_items, sponsors, banners and contact_messages.
Public content endpoints and private admin CRUD endpoints already wired to the frontend.
adaptation_steps: Adapt station/brand name, tagline, live stream, editorial tone and public navigation in app-config/layout/home.
Reuse existing content endpoints for public pages and admin CRUD; do not create duplicate article/program/media endpoints.
Customize program/article/media fields only if the user's media workflow needs it.
Verify public contact and admin editorial pages compile after changes.
do_not_rebuild: Do not rebuild the CMS/editorial backend from scratch.
Do not duplicate content tables or endpoints for programs, articles, media, hosts or messages.
Do not move admin routes out of /admin or remove the auth boundary.
Do not turn this into ecommerce/booking; choose another template for those intents.
agent_brief.first_build_goal: A branded public media site with working live/schedule/content surfaces and a protected editorial admin that preserves the existing backend.
completion_checks: Public home, schedule, programs, articles, multimedia, team and contact routes compile.
Admin editorial pages under /admin compile and remain protected.
Contact form uses submit-contact-message and remains public.
The agent reused existing media station tables/endpoints.

must_reuse: admin-* editorial endpoints for protected management
may_extend: Add podcast platform embeds or newsletter endpoints
Add public pages for sponsors or live events
must_not_duplicate: Do not create duplicate article/program/media/host/contact tables
Do not create duplicate content CRUD endpoints
Do not create custom auth tables/endpoints

media_plan.guidance: Media brands benefit from strong imagery. Generate a coherent hero plus program/host visual system when the user asks for a branded first build.

agent_instructions: Use this template when the user asks for a radio, podcast, media outlet, news, magazine or content-channel app. Do not mention the internal template name to the end user. Preserve the mixed surface: public content pages plus protected admin. Reuse existing DYPAI endpoints and tables; adapt copy, branding, colors, content examples and admin labels to the user's project. Public features should use public endpoints; admin management stays protected.

fonts.display: Inter with 800/900 weights for broadcast/editorial headlines

palette.intent: dark editorial/broadcast base with vivid blue primary

design_system.guidance: Keep the public brand energetic and editorial. Retune HSL tokens in src/index.css for the station identity; preserve strong contrast, media cards and admin readability.
